verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a block-based editor with some keyboard input: `((` for block references, `@`/`[[]]` for links, Cmd/Ctrl U to create objects, block embedding, and images that become reusable objects you can place in content. It never documents the specific formatting elements the story names. Missing for 10: documented headings, callouts, tables and code blocks; evidence of a broadly keyboard-driven editing workflow (slash commands, formatting shortcuts) and of editor speed; independent or hands-on corroboration of editing quality.
